metadata.title: Platform Time Observability and Telemetry

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for providing visibility into time behavior to support monitoring, investigation, and trust assurance.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Time synchronization telemetry, drift metrics, logging, and audit data supporting operational and security visibility.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern enabling visibility into time correctness and behavior without embedding enforcement or time semantics into the platform.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Time observability depends on resilient time services to produce meaningful and trustworthy telemetry.

metadata.remarks: Platform Time Observability and Telemetry defines expectations for visibility into time synchronization, drift, and availability. It supports Security Operations and platform owners in detecting anomalies, investigating incidents, and validating time-related trust assumptions.

components.title: Time Synchronization Telemetry
components.description: Provides telemetry describing synchronization state between platform systems and authoritative time sources.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Time manipulation or desynchronization that goes unnoticed due to lack of synchronization visibility.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Operational telemetry enabling detection of anomalous system state.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Time synchronization state is monitored to detect anomalous or degraded conditions.

components.title: Time Drift Telemetry
components.description: Provides metrics and signals describing clock drift and skew across platform systems.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Service or security degradation caused by undetected clock divergence.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Continuous monitoring of operational metrics to detect destabilizing conditions.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Time drift telemetry supports integrity assurance of platform services.

components.title: Time Investigation Support
components.description: Supports correlation and analysis of time-related events during incident response and forensic investigation.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Obfuscation of malicious activity through manipulation or lack of time audit data.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Retention and correlation of event data to support investigation and accountability.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Time-related telemetry and logs support investigation and incident analysis.
